conventions.convention: Momentum space is M = R³ minus {0}, with dν = d³k/(2|k|). Transversality means k·f(k) = 0 almost everywhere; the Hermitian pairing is conjugate-linear in its first variable and linear in its second.
The cross product is extended complex-linearly with ε123 = 1; P = I − nnᵀ, h = i(n×·), and Pσ = (P + σh)/2 for σ = ±1.
Rotations act by U(R)f(k) = Rf(R⁻¹k), with U(Ra(t)) = exp(−itJa/ℏ), ℏ > 0.

S′i is the bounded multiplier ℏni h; L′i = Ji − S′i has exact domain D(Ji). Commutators use [A,B] = AB − BA and are asserted on the invariant smooth transverse domain D, not on unrestricted operator-product domains.
Helicity scalarization uses Borel unit sections, without asserting global continuity or smoothness.

Fock sectors start at n = 0, with vacuum sector C. Dh is the maximal self-adjoint sector multiplier; equality Dh = N+ − N− is stated on finite-particle vectors. Free propagation uses exp(−it|k|), with t having length units when k has inverse-length units and c = 1.
Scalarization assumes Countable Choice; the rotation, projected-operator, Fock-lift and example arguments assume full Choice, which supplies Countable Choice.

load_bearing.statement: Assume the Axiom of Choice and ℏ > 0. Define S′i = MℏPSiP = Mℏni h and L′i = Ji − S′i on the exact domain D(Ji). The S′i are bounded self-adjoint and preserve D.
Assume the Axiom of Choice and ℏ > 0. For every unit axis a ∈ S², D is a core for Ja: it is contained in D(Ja) and is dense in that domain for the graph norm.

Under Choice and ℏ > 0, each L′i is self-adjoint on D(Ji), and D is a common graph core for Ji and L′i. On D, [Ji,Jj] = iℏΣk εijkJk, [S′i,S′j] = 0, [L′i,S′j] = iℏΣk εijkS′k, and [L′i,L′j] = iℏΣk εijk(L′k − S′k).

Assume Countable Choice. There are Borel unit helicity sections eσ whose fiber coefficients define a unitary T from the transverse space onto L²(M × {+1,−1}, dν ⊗ counting measure); T intertwines h with multiplication by σ and Pσ with the corresponding indicator multiplier.

Assume Choice and ℏ > 0. The Fock rotation lift is a strongly continuous unitary representation with self-adjoint Stone generators acting by sector sums on the stated tensor domain. The maximal helicity-number difference commutes with free radial propagation. For normalized helicity-σ f, ⟨f,S′zf⟩ν = ℏσ∫M cos θ(k)|f(k)|² dν(k).

seams_checked.note: Checked the weighted-space isometry, helicity projectors, rotation action and Stone-generator statements against their uses. The batch preserves the measure, pairing, helicity sign, Choice hypotheses and differential-expression restriction to D. Its graph-core assertion is proved locally rather than attributed to the rotation supplier. Borel scalarization does not contradict the obstruction to smooth global helicity frames. The supplier's rotation-isometry diagram agrees with its substitution identity.

Checked the paraxial definitions and packet, spin-error and spin-to-orbit propositions against this batch. They retain S′z = ℏnz h, L′z = Jz − S′z on D(Jz), and the normalized helicity expectation identity. Orbital expectations use packets in D(Jz); unitary balance explicitly assumes domain preservation and axial commutation. The north-gauge winding remains a local label, and the conclusions retain their conditional mathematical scope.
